boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten documented destinations around UM-Dearborn, with one concrete reason to stop along each corridor.

cards.entity_name: Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation
cards.title: Henry Ford Museum of American Innovation
cards.subtitle: Oakwood Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Plan a museum visit to examine collections and exhibits about American innovation; use the official schedule before traveling to the Oakwood Boulevard entrance.
cards.short_summary: A large history-of-innovation museum at The Henry Ford.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henry Ford identifies this as one of its public venues and lists standard museum hours of 9:30 a.m.–5 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Explore Museum & Village Venues | The Henry Ford
cards.access_notes: The official venue page lists daily standard hours; confirm the live schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Greenfield Village
cards.subtitle: Village Road and Oakwood Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Choose a day when the village is operating and explore its historic buildings, working farms, open-air market, and scheduled experiences at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: An 80-acre living-history destination within The Henry Ford campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henry Ford describes Greenfield Village as 80 acres of living history with working farms, an open-air market, Model T rides, and historic buildings.
cards.source_title: Explore Museum & Village Venues | The Henry Ford
cards.access_notes: Admission tickets are required; check the official schedule and seasonal operations before going.

cards.title: Ford Rouge Factory Tour
cards.subtitle: Oakwood Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for the multisensory factory-tour experience, then follow the official arrival and ticket guidance for the Dearborn Truck Plant visit.
cards.short_summary: A ticketed tour focused on Ford F-150 manufacturing and automotive innovation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henry Ford says the Ford Rouge Factory Tour is housed at Ford Motor Company's Dearborn Truck Plant and covers manufacturing, including the Ford F-150.
cards.source_title: Explore Museum & Village Venues | The Henry Ford
cards.access_notes: The official venue page lists the tour as closed Sundays; reserve and verify the current schedule.

cards.title: Giant Screen Experience
cards.subtitle: Oakwood Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the current film lineup and reserve a showing for a large-format 4K digital 2D or 3D screening at The Henry Ford campus.
cards.short_summary: A cinema venue for scheduled large-format films.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henry Ford describes the Giant Screen Experience as a venue with state-of-the-art 4K digital, 2D and 3D projection.
cards.source_title: Explore Museum & Village Venues | The Henry Ford
cards.access_notes: Consult the official venue schedule for showtimes and ticket availability.

cards.title: Ford Community & Performing Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Michigan Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the center's official page to plan a recreation visit; its listed facilities include pools, gyms, fitness space, studios, meeting rooms, and a theater.
cards.short_summary: A municipal recreation and arts complex on Michigan Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Dearborn lists two gyms, two pools, fitness space, group-exercise studios, meeting rooms, a gallery, and the Guido Theater at the center.
cards.source_title: Ford Community & Performing Arts Center | City of Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Located at 15801 Michigan Ave.; the city lists general facility hours on its official page.

cards.title: Michael A. Guido Theater
cards.subtitle: Michigan Avenue corridor, inside the Ford Community & Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Look at the theater's current calendar and select a family-theater, class, symphony, or musical event that fits your schedule before buying tickets.
cards.short_summary: A regional performance venue housed within the civic center.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Dearborn identifies the Michael A. Guido Theater as a professional regional theater presenting family theater, classes, symphony orchestra, and musicals.
cards.source_title: Michael A. Guido Theater | City of Dearborn
cards.access_notes: Located at 15801 Michigan Ave. inside the Ford Community & Performing Arts Center; event access varies by program.

cards.title: Padzieski Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Michigan Avenue corridor, west wing of the Ford Community & Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Visit during the posted gallery window to see current work, and check the city page for special exhibit or holiday-market schedule changes before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A public art gallery for rotating exhibits and arts programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Dearborn says the Padzieski Art Gallery exhibits work by established and emerging artists and hosts special events, classes, workshops, and programs.
cards.source_title: Padzieski Art Gallery | City of Dearborn
cards.access_notes: The city lists the gallery at 15801 Michigan Ave. and regular Wednesday–Saturday hours; verify exhibit access before visiting.

cards.title: Henry Ford Centennial Library
cards.subtitle: Michigan Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Bring a research question, browse the stacks, or use the library's public spaces; consult its location page for the current day’s opening hours.
cards.short_summary: Dearborn's main public-library location on Michigan Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Dearborn Public Library lists the Henry Ford Centennial Library at 16301 Michigan Ave. and publishes its weekly hours.
cards.source_title: Hours and Locations | Dearborn Public Library
cards.access_notes: Located at 16301 Michigan Ave.; the library lists Monday–Thursday, Friday–Saturday, and Sunday hours, subject to holiday closures.

cards.title: Arab American National Museum
cards.subtitle: Michigan Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Set aside time for the museum's original exhibitions and cultural programming, and review its official admission and holiday information before visiting the downtown site.
cards.short_summary: A museum documenting Arab American histories, experiences, and contributions.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that it documents and shares Arab American contributions and presents original exhibitions, art, film screenings, and performances.
cards.access_notes: Located at 13624 Michigan Ave.; standard general admission is listed as $10, with specific discounted and free categories.

cards.title: Ford Field Park
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the park for a daytime walk, picnic, or recreation stop; the city lists ball fields, courts, a soccer field, a sledding hill, and Rouge River access.
cards.short_summary: A municipal community park with varied outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Dearborn lists Ford Field Park at 500 Monroe and identifies its playground, ball fields, tennis court, soccer field, sledding hill, picnic amenities, and Rouge River.
cards.access_notes: Located at 500 Monroe; amenities and reservable spaces are listed by the City of Dearborn.
